description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohoddaramulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530014 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and ownership details) in various villages, with detailed schedules showing land ownership, extents, encumbrances, and mortgages. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
